title: Jehoiakim (high priest)
summary: High priest in Hales’s seventh period, 30 years. Not Jehoiakim the king of Judah.
description: Added from the Hales import. Display only. Hales prints his own B.C. years in the synopsis and in Table XI. This chronology never sets a sort, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person’s birth, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Hales is display-only).

standby.note: Standby placement only. Hales, A New Analysis of Chronology (1830, 2nd ed.) prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (2. High priest, Jehoiakim, 30 years 483). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.
